register.title: Kevin Fang's three two-wedge certificates at c75bebd, issue484
register.headline: A packing of 308 squares below the grid, from Kevin Fang
register.source_checks: The author reports that three checkers accept all three certificates: Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py, unchanged; David Ellsworth's check_packing.py on the 40-digit exports, which prints Container OK and Overlaps NONE; and the author's own verify.py, which shares the half-angle representation and the separating-axis test with Daniel's. Their outputs are retained; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit the packings to Kevin Fang (https://github.com/TheSnakeFang/squarepack-certs). They extend the k^2 - k + 1 two-wedge family of Arslanov, Mustafin and Shangitbayev (Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 28(4), P4.22, 2021) one k up and one square past it, grown from David Ellsworth's and Tej Stead's packings of 273 and 307 squares on the Kingbird table; the certificate format is Evan Daniel's and the JSON layout SQUISH's. The search, the verifier and the bundle were written with Claude under the author's direction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then record source-specific adoption of the n308 side, where the case holds the grid's 18 in both lanes, with confirming evidence. The n343 and n344 sides stay beyond-horizon rows. Final exact-head CI remains required.
